{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-mi-s","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"1c9d49d7377611b09909c832ab2a887e190ccf3e8859f926895dee0c7d60b8e9","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-mi-class-std:lineage:60","source_registry_sha256":"7af7437894a2c63b20529c8a1ed7c10696796036051dd6666178ab579008ca37","source_liveness_sha256":"e81e5179580dc89fb25fdf5194e9f75291db3aa019fc21ccfe32c38d1a9df42f"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Stopping distances, night driving, emergencies and crashes","heading":"C2 — Trip preparation, personal safety, disabled vehicles, traffic stops, confusables and KG hints","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Trip preparation, personal safety, disabled vehicles, traffic stops, confusables and KG hints

FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A03
Plan ahead: keep the vehicle in good repair, carry enough gas, and tell someone your route and expected arrival time. [A03]
Why it matters: group trip preparation; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables none [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A03
Make sure headlights, taillights, brake lights and turn signals are clean and working, since defective or missing equipment can get you ticketed. [A03]
Why it matters: group trip preparation; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A03
Clean the windshield and windows, check tire inflation, damage and wear, and look in front of and behind the vehicle for objects, animals or people. [A03]
Why it matters: group trip preparation; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables none [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A03
Etching the vehicle identification number on windows and main parts helps prevent theft for parts, and alarms and interlocks can discourage amateur carjackers. [A03]
Why it matters: group theft prevention; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables none [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A03
Before starting the engine, sit comfortably, make sure everyone is buckled, check the mirrors and look again for anything in your path. [A03]
Why it matters: group before driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables none [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A03
Most cars have at least two blind spots, to the left rear and right rear, that side mirrors cannot show; set the inside mirror to show the center of the road behind you. [A03]
Why it matters: group mirrors; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-R07 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A03
Set the outside mirrors so the vehicle's edges just show from a normal seating position, or for fewer blind spots lean left to the window to set the left mirror and lean right to the center to set the right one. [A03]
Why it matters: group mirrors; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-R06 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A03
Never turn the ignition to lock while moving, because the steering locks and you lose control if you try to steer. [A03]
Why it matters: group risks; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables none [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R09 | anchor: A03
Keep doors and windows locked, prefer freeways over streets through high-crime areas, and know where help such as a police station or open business is nearby. [A03]
Why it matters: group personal safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables none [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R10 | anchor: A03
Neither hitchhike nor give rides to hitchhikers, keep keys out of the parked car and its ignition, and shut the sunroof at night and in risky areas. [A03]
Why it matters: group personal safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables none [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R11 | anchor: A03
With a flat tire, do not get out to fix it; drive slowly to a well-lit service station or store lot and phone for help. [A03]
Why it matters: group personal safety; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-R14 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R12 | anchor: A03
Choose the safest route, park close to your destination, have keys ready when returning, and check inside the car for intruders before getting in. [A03]
Why it matters: group personal safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables none [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R13 | anchor: A04
If someone suspicious approaches your car, drive away or sound the horn, stay inside with doors locked, and call for help by mobile phone, which Michigan law allows for emergencies. [A04]
Why it matters: group personal safety; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R14 | anchor: A04
If a carjacker wants your vehicle, give it up without a fight, stay calm and note a good description. [A04]
Why it matters: group personal safety; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R15 | anchor: A04
If your car breaks down, pull as far off the traveled road as possible, turn on the four-way flashers, and stay inside buckled up; the handbook recommends a trained, equipped professional assist with the vehicle. [A04]
Why it matters: group disabled vehicles; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec14-R11 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R16 | anchor: A04
If you must leave a disabled vehicle, watch traffic and walk straight to a safe spot far from the road, since walking on a freeway is dangerous and illegal. [A04]
Why it matters: group disabled vehicles; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R17 | anchor: A04
When an officer signals you to pull over, pull off to the right as soon as it is safe and stop, stay calm, and follow orders without making movements that could escalate things. [A04]
Why it matters: group traffic stops; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R18 | anchor: A04
During a stop, stay in the car buckled, turn on interior lights after dusk, open the window, keep empty hands on the wheel, and ask passengers to stay quiet with hands visible. [A04]
Why it matters: group traffic stops; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R19 | anchor: A04
Take out your license, registration and insurance card only when asked, and tell the officer where they are first. [A04]
Why it matters: group traffic stops; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R20 | anchor: A04
Do not argue about the stop or a ticket; take a ticket dispute to the court, and report officer conduct you think was inappropriate to the officer's supervisor. [A04]
Why it matters: group traffic stops; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R21 | anchor: A04
An officer's directions take priority over other traffic control devices. [A04]
Why it matters: group conclusion; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R22 | anchor: A04
Avoid staring at any one thing for more than a few seconds, and increase following distance at night, in bad weather, at rush hour, during lane changes and near intersections. [A04]
Why it matters: group conclusion; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec14-R23 | anchor: A01
Following distance starts at 3 to 4 seconds and may rise to 6 seconds or more, while looking ahead means scanning 20 to 30 seconds down the road. [A01]
Why it matters: group distances; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec14-F02, sec14-F04, sec14-F06 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R24 | anchor: A01
Both headlight rules use 500 feet: lights go on when you cannot see clearly at that distance, and high beams go off within that distance of oncoming traffic. [A01]
Why it matters: group headlights; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec14-F10, sec14-F12 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R25 | anchor: A02
Police must be notified when a crash causes any injury or more than $1,000 in property damage, and a drivable vehicle in a crash without serious injury or death must still be moved off the main road when safe. [A02]
Why it matters: group crashes; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec14-F19, sec14-F21 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0079]
